recommendation: Defer formal whole-S014 pause; propose one bounded exit-action test. Do not resume account experiments.
mechanism: At the first actual support break, common market/sector decline with stock relative resilience may distinguish recoverable shocks from extra stock weakness.
signal: D first support-break decision close before original E+9. C=(market_return_D<0 and sector_return_D<0); R=(stock_return_D-sector_return_D>=0). Fixed daily close-to-close returns, zero boundaries, exact dates. Missing is not zero.
action: Continue to original H10 only when P<=0 and C and R; otherwise original early exit. No repeated decision or extended deadline.
existing_label: Same-entry B net position return minus R net position return, reused from EX023; no new labels.
comparison_population: All 100 matched closed early-exit events, report 85/15 separately, all seven entry/decision years with explicit date semantics; not only failed years.
comparability: Inspect same-year, same-remaining-days common support and own decline, amplitude, floating PnL distributions. No claim of full confounding adjustment from this zero-fit test.
negative_result_action: Close mechanism; no reverse direction, nearby threshold, new model or automatic data expansion.
insufficient_common_support_action: Report inconclusive; stop this design without automatic extension.
positive_result_action: Review coverage, alternative explanations and account integration before seeking separate authorization; no automatic component promotion.
